annotations.title: OCR a scanned PDF or image

description:
Queue a scanned PDF, PNG or JPEG for OCR with OCRmyPDF and Tesseract.

The result is the same document with a searchable text layer, as PDF/A
by default. Pass the file as base64 in `content_base64` (up to 4 MB) or
as a download link in `file` (up to 25 MB), and its name in `filename`.
Up to 200 pages; an image is one page.

Returns `job_id`, `status`, `pages` and `credits`. Call
`get_ocr_result` with the `job_id` until `status` is `succeeded` or
`failed`; a job is stopped after 15 minutes.

Requires an API key. Costs 2 credits per page, charged now and
refunded if the job fails. The result is kept for 7 days.

content_base64.description: The file content, base64-encoded. Up to 4 MB before encoding.

deskew.description: Straighten crooked pages. Not with mode=redo.

file.description: The file as a download link, instead of `content_base64`. In ChatGPT, pass the user's uploaded file here. Other clients can set `download_url` to a public https URL.

download_url.description: A public https URL of the file.

file_id.description: An identifier for the file. ChatGPT sets it; other clients may pass any label, such as the file name.

filename.description: The file name with its extension: .pdf, .png, .jpg or .jpeg.

language.description: The document's language: eng, deu, spa or fra.

mode.description: Pages that already have text: skip them (the default), redo an earlier OCR layer, or force OCR on every page as an image.

rotate_pages.description: Turn pages that are upside down or sideways.
